answer: Customers can request a refund within 30 days of purchase. Refunds go back to the original payment method.
Merchants have 7 days to submit evidence after a chargeback notice.
A chargeback fee of 15 USD is charged for every dispute, whether or not the merchant wins.
Businesses provide registration documents and the details of every beneficial owner holding 25 percent or more.
International cards cost 2.9 percent plus 0.30 USD, plus an extra 1.5 percent. Premium merchants get a 0.5 percent loyalty discount on all international volume.
Retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of creating a second charge. Keys expire after 24 hours.
API keys should be rotated at least every 90 days.
Failed deliveries are retried with exponential backoff, so the same event can be delivered more than once. Receivers should process events idempotently.
Transaction records are retained for 7 years to meet financial record-keeping obligations.
Back off and retry after the time in the Retry-After header instead of failing immediately.
